newsitem.title: USA: First Data TeleCheck buys Canada franchise.
newsitem.headline: First Data TeleCheck buys Canada franchise.

text.p: First Data Corp's TeleCheck International Inc said Tuesday it acquired its Canadian franchise, TeleCheque Canada, from Vancouver-based Continental Commercial Systems Corp.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.
TeleCheck International will operate in Canada through its subsidiary, TeleCheck Services Canada. The franchise served about 4,000 merchant locations throughout Canada.
The company said it will be introducing new products and services to its Canadian subscribers.
The TeleCheck system provides check acceptance, check guarantee and collection services to retail, financial institution, travel and other clients.
